overview.purpose_zh: 把整体压成一条横条，按占比切成几段；段长就是百分比，适合空间很小的地方快速看构成。
works_zh: 只要看构成，不需要精确比较每一段的具体数值
放在卡片、表格或邮件里，一行就能交代整体
段数少、长短差别明显时，读者从左往右扫一眼就懂
uses_zh: 仪表盘卡片里的构成条
周报或邮件简报的一行总览
汇报开场的一页结构图

understanding.read_zh: 整条横条是 100%，每一段的长度就是它的占比。先看最左边最宽的一段 Coal，再依次看后面的段；段多而且长度接近时，横条会很难分辨，最好换成分组柱状图或表格。

elements.note_zh: 整条代表 100%，不是某一个来源的数值。
每一段的长度对应一个来源的占比。
段上或列表里写出的百分比，帮读者对上具体数字。
颜色和来源的对应关系，段太窄时只能靠它认。

look_for_zh: Coal 最宽，占 26%，刚过四分之一
化石燃料三段合起来 51%，刚过半条
Oil 只有 3%，窄到几乎看不清

observations.en: Coal is the widest segment at 26 percent, just over a quarter of the bar.
observations.zh: 煤是最宽的一段，占 26%，略高于横条的四分之一。

observations.en: The three fossil segments together take 51 percent, just over half of the bar.
observations.zh: 三段化石燃料合计占 51%，刚过横条的一半。

observations.en: Oil is the narrowest segment at 3 percent.
observations.zh: 石油是最窄的一段，只占 3%。

observations.en: Wind and nuclear are close, at 12 percent and 14 percent.
observations.zh: 风电和核能很接近，分别为 12% 和 14%。

describe.en: The segmented bar shows the electricity mix in one line, with each segment sized by its share.
describe.zh: 这条分段条用一行展示电力结构，每一段的长度由占比决定。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The segmented bar puts the whole electricity mix into a single line.
This chart shows how generation splits by source along one bar.
describe.note_zh: 先说“一行”和“按占比”，读者就知道这不是比较绝对数量。

describe.en: Coal accounts for 26 percent, the widest segment in the bar.
describe.zh: 煤占 26%，是横条里最宽的一段。
describe.pattern: X accounts for + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: Coal makes up 26 percent of the bar.
Coal represents 26 percent of total generation.

describe.en: Coal, gas and oil make up 51 percent of the bar, just over half.
describe.zh: 煤、天然气和石油合计占横条的 51%，刚过一半。
describe.pattern: X makes up + percentage + of + whole
alternatives: The three fossil fuels account for 51 percent of the bar.
Fossil fuels together make up just over half of generation.
describe.note_zh: 把同类的窄段合成一组，横条读起来就不碎了。

describe.en: Coal leads at 26 percent, closely followed by gas at 22 percent.
describe.zh: 煤以 26% 领先，天然气以 22% 紧随其后。
describe.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B
alternatives: Coal comes first at 26 percent, with gas close behind at 22 percent.
Gas follows coal closely, at 22 percent against 26 percent.

describe.en: Coal's share is 4 percentage points higher than gas, at 26 percent against 22 percent.
describe.zh: 煤的份额比天然气高 4 个百分点，为 26% 对 22%。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure
alternatives: Coal is 4 percentage points above gas.
At 26 percent, coal sits 4 percentage points above gas at 22 percent.
describe.note_zh: 报差距时把两个端点都写出来，读者不用回图里找。

describe.en: Gas is just under a quarter of the bar, at 22 percent.
describe.zh: 天然气占横条略低于四分之一，为 22%。
alternatives: Gas is a little below a quarter, at 22 percent.
At 22 percent, gas falls just short of a quarter of the bar.

academic.en: The segmented bar shows the share of electricity generation by source as one horizontal bar whose full length represents 100 percent. Coal is the widest segment at 26 percent, followed by gas at 22 percent and oil at 3 percent, so fossil fuels together occupy 51 percent of the bar. Renewables account for 35 percent, comprising hydro 15 percent, wind 12 percent and solar 8 percent. Nuclear makes up the remaining 14 percent. The compact form is suited to an overview, though segments of similar width are difficult to compare by eye.
academic.zh: 这张分段条形图把各发电来源的占比画成一根水平条，整根条代表 100%。煤炭是最宽的一段，占 26%，其次是天然气 22% 和石油 3%，因此化石能源合计占整根条的 51%。可再生能源占 35%，包括水电 15%、风电 12% 和太阳能 8%。核能占剩下的 14%。这种紧凑形式适合做概览，但宽度接近的分段用眼睛很难比较。

business.en: If our dashboard has room for only one line, this bar carries the headline: fossil fuels still take 51 percent of generation, just over half. Coal is the widest segment at 26 percent, gas follows at 22 percent, and oil is only 3 percent. Renewables cover 35 percent, with hydro at 15 percent, wind at 12 percent and solar at 8 percent. Nuclear adds 14 percent. Our eye reads the big blocks first and skips the narrow ones. We should keep this bar on the summary card and use a different view when we need to compare the small sources.
business.zh: 如果我们的看板只能放一行图，这根条就承担了主要信息：化石能源仍占发电量的 51%，略高于一半。煤炭是最宽的一段，占 26%，天然气占 22%，石油只有 3%。可再生能源占 35%，其中水电 15%、风电 12%、太阳能 8%，核能占 14%。人的视线会先看大块，跳过窄条。我们应把这根条留在概览卡片上，需要比较小的来源时再换一种视图。

simple.en: This is one bar that shows where electricity comes from. The whole bar is 100 percent. Coal takes the biggest part at 26 percent. Gas is next at 22 percent. Oil is a thin strip at 3 percent. Renewables take 35 percent: hydro 15, wind 12 and solar 8. Nuclear takes 14 percent. Big pieces are easy to read. Thin pieces are hard to compare.
simple.zh: 这是一根显示电力来源的条形。整根条是 100%。煤炭占最大一块，为 26%，天然气紧随其后为 22%，石油只是很窄的一条，占 3%。可再生能源占 35%：水电 15，风电 12，太阳能 8。核能占 14%。大块很好读，窄条很难比较。

language_notes.body_zh: 横条里说 widest segment 是在描述图的形状，largest share 是在描述数据。两者常常指同一段，但别混着写：段有宽度，数据有份额。
examples: Coal is the widest segment at 26 percent.
Coal holds the largest share at 26 percent.

language_notes.body_zh: 两段相减用 percentage points，不写 percent。煤 26% 和天然气 22% 差 4 个百分点，说 4 percentage points；说 4 percent 会被理解成相对变化。
examples: Coal is 4 percentage points above gas.
Coal is 26 percent and gas is 22 percent.

language_notes.body_zh: 22% 差一点点到四分之一，用 just under a quarter；26% 则是 just over a quarter。just 让读者知道差得很小，比笼统的 more than 或 less than 更精确。
examples: Gas is just under a quarter of the bar, at 22 percent.
Coal is just over a quarter of the bar, at 26 percent.
